title: Trace of the copying machine
statement: Let $M$ be the copying machine, with distinct source and destination tape indices $s,d$. Let $w$ be a word and let $c$ be a configuration in the sweep phase. Suppose the source tape contains $w$ at every offset from $-1$ through $|w|$, relative to its head position, with blank cells outside the word. Then for every time $t$, the run from $c$ follows the piecewise trace consisting of the forward configuration at time $t$ for $t\le |w|$, the rewind configuration indexed by $2|w|+1-t$ for $|w|<t\le2|w|+1$, and the completed configuration thereafter. In the completed configuration the destination tape has the copied word as specified by the forward configuration at progress $|w|$.
hypotheses_covered: Initial configuration is in the sweep phase
Source tape agrees with the buffer for every offset $-1\le p\le |w|$
